messages:
carol (auditor): Morning. Auditor ask: we need evidence for the RBAC change on 2026-02-15 that removed `svc-admin` from `team-data` and the subsequent KMS key rotation that was used to re-encrypt CVA artifacts. Please provide: 1) change request ticket, 2) audit log slice showing who approved and applied the change, 3) KMS rotation record (old key id -> new key id), 4) manifest of re-encrypted objects with checksums, and 5) brief chain-of-custody. Also include verification steps we can run.

ryan (sec-eng): Got it. Short answers up-front: ticket = RDW-4821, approver = nina, executor = dave, change type = IAM principal removal + role binding update, applied via Terraform pipeline. KMS rotation used `alias/redwood/cva` -> new key ARN `arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/fedcba98-7654-3210-ffff-0123456789ab` (rotation performed 2026-02-16).

nina (infra): I'll export the CloudTrail events for the window 2026-02-15T08:00..2026-02-15T12:00 UTC where the iam:RemoveRoleFromInstanceProfile and iam:PutRolePolicy events and the CodePipeline/Apply events show the change. Query we used: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=PutRolePolicy --start-time 2026-02-15T08:00:00Z --end-time 2026-02-15T12:00:00Z`

nina (infra): Exported events -> `s3://redwood-audit-exports/3112349999/cloudtrail-events.json.gz` (object lock enabled, retention=365 days).

dave (devops): Re-encryption of CVA artifacts done by job `recrypt-job-2026-02-16` which calls our rewrap service. Re-encrypt manifest created at `s3://redwood-cva-manifests/recrypt-2026-02-16/manifest.json` containing per-object sha256 + old_key_id + new_key_id. Example manifest entry: {"s3_key": "cva/2026/obj-12345.enc", "sha256": "8b1a9953c4611296a827abf8c47804d7", "old_key": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd1234...", "new_key": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/fedcba98..."}

dave (devops): Commands auditors can run to verify rewrap integrity (we include README in export): ```bash
# download manifest
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-cva-manifests/recrypt-2026-02-16/manifest.json ./manifest.json
# download one object
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-cva-artifacts/cva/2026/obj-12345.enc ./obj-12345.enc
# compute checksum and compare
sha256sum obj-12345.enc
# result should match manifest sha256
```

ryan (sec-eng): For KMS rotation provenance: we recorded the rotation via AWS KMS ScheduleKeyDeletion / CreateKey + Grant rotation metadata in Dynamo `kms_rotations` table. Exported rotation log: `s3://redwood-audit-exports/3112349999/kms-rotation-log.json` with fields (rotation_id, old_key_arn, new_key_arn, initiated_by, timestamp, ticket). We'll include KMS CMK alias mapping and IAM policy snippet that grants `kms:ReEncrypt*` to `recrypt-service-role`.

carol (auditor): Good. Two quick clarifications: (A) need the IAM policy showing who can call KMS:ReEncrypt and KMS:Decrypt for both old and new keys; (B) please include proof that the RBAC removal prevented further access after change (e.g., an access denied event for the removed principal).

nina (infra): IAM snippet included in export: `iam_policy_ts-3112349999.txt`. It has the principal list and statements. Example:```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":["arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/recrypt-service-role","arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/security-audit"]},"Action":["kms:ReEncrypt*","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/*"}]}```

nina (infra): Also pulled CloudTrail access denied event for principal `arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/svc-admin` at 2026-02-15T13:02:11Z where code=AccessDenied when trying to `s3:GetObject` on `cva/2026/obj-12345.enc`. That proves removal prevented access. Event exported in same cloudtrail file.

dave (devops): Chain of custody: `chain_of_custody.md` will list ticket RDW-4821, change author ryan, approver nina, executor dave, recrypt-job id, S3 export paths, and evidence-bot export id `exp-3112349999`. We'll set object-lock retention on the export bundle for 180 days.

ryan (sec-eng): Deliverables we will publish to `s3://redwood-audit-exports/3112349999/`: - RDW-4821-change-request.pdf - cloudtrail-events.json.gz - iam_policy_ts-3112349999.txt - kms-rotation-log.json - recrypt-manifest.json - sample-obj-12345.enc (encrypted) - chain_of_custody.md - README_verification.md

ryan (sec-eng): README_verification.md includes verification steps: sha256 checks, CloudTrail event correlation (eventId timestamps), KMS key ARN check (`aws kms describe-key --key-id <key-arn>`), and example `aws kms re-encrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://obj-12345.enc --source-key-id <old> --destination-key-id <new>` to validate rewrap (note: auditors won't be given Decrypt rights; they verify manifests and metadata).

carol (auditor): One more: there was a brief incident on 2026-02-14 (INC-2109) flagged for suspicious access pattern to cva bucket. Please include a short incident response summary that ties INC-2109 to the RBAC change if related.

ryan (sec-eng): Incident note: INC-2109 was triaged; root cause = mis-scoped svc-admin role used by a CI job. We rotated keys as a precaution and removed svc-admin from team-data on 02-15. Evidence: CI job logs showing `assume-role` and the remediation ticket RDW-4799 linked in chain_of_custody. No signs of data exfiltration; system showed only metadata reads. We'll include IR summary: `inc-2109-summary.pdf` with timeline and artifacts.

carol (auditor): Great. ETA?

evidence-bot: export prepared: s3://redwood-audit-exports/3112349999/rbac-kms-rotation-handback.zip (size=18MB), manifest_sha256=9e107d9d372bb6826bd81d3542a419d6

carol (auditor): Thanks team — I'll download and run the verification steps tomorrow. If I need Decrypt/Verify access for KMS signatures I'll raise an access request. Appreciated.
